config.scope_policy: Original authorized source only. Separate oracle and frozen whole-question BM25-v1 diagnostic records; neighborhood-v2 not registered.
config.source_evidence: Same authorized source edges and collisions as v1d; source names grouped by original language, predicate IRI local names extracted mechanically. No translations, invented property definitions, selected IDs or gold directions.

repeatability.gate: Diagnostic measurement only; failed repeat recorded. Exact prompt and request identity mismatch is a fatal integrity failure.

rationale_review.method: Blind independent human review pending; source sufficiency audit is AI investigator analysis only.
rationale_review.gate: No semantic GO; unsupported or unreviewed claims are not validated.
